title.zh: 05 |工艺旋钮：功率不是唯一答案
title.en: 05 | Process parameters: power is not the only answer

subtitle.zh: 压力、气体、温度、频率和脉冲共同改变Plasma
subtitle.en: Pressure, gas, temperature, frequency and pulsing jointly change Plasma

body.en: Pressure: Mean Free Path, collisions and IADF

body.zh: 温度：吸附、反应、解吸与副产物
body.en: Temperature: Adsorption, reaction, desorption and byproducts

body.zh: 功率/频率：电子加热、解离、Flux与Sheath
body.en: Power / frequency: Electron heating, dissociation, Flux and Sheath

body.zh: 低压力：方向性↑｜稳定性/均匀性挑战↑
body.en: Low pressure: Directionality ↑ | stability / uniformity challenges ↑
Passivation ↑: Sidewall protection ↑ | Necking / Etch Stop risk ↑
Bias ↑: Bottom clearing ↑ | Mask Loss / Damage ↑

body.zh: 温度↑：解吸↑｜选择性与Polymer窗口改变
body.en: Temperature ↑: Desorption ↑ | selectivity and Polymer windows change
Common signs of loss of control

body.zh: 一次只看Power，很容易把化学、输运和Chamber State混在一起。
body.en: Looking only at Power can easily conflate chemistry, transport and Chamber State.

body.zh: 边界：提高Power不一定提高Etch Rate；当气体耗尽、解离饱和或表面反应受限时，趋势可能反转。
body.en: Boundary: increasing Power does not necessarily increase Etch Rate; trends may reverse with gas depletion, saturated dissociation or surface-reaction limitations.
